verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Klaviyo lets marketers 'build automations' via drag-and-drop editors and event-triggered flows (e.g., gifting flows), but nothing in the evidence pack specifically documents branching logic, time delays, or exit rules within those flows. missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional branching, delay/wait steps, and exit-rule configuration in flows; independent/hands-on corroboration of these specific flow-building mechanics.
